items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen questions Ferrari’s decision to let Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc race freely
items.summaryEn: After winning the Mexico City Grand Prix, Verstappen said that if he were Ferrari's team principal he would never pair two number one drivers and let them race freely, believing the first-lap battle between Hamilton and Leclerc gifted him the win.
detailZh: 维斯塔潘质疑法拉利放任汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔自由竞争的决定
这位红牛车手认为，法拉利在首圈的争夺让他得以在墨西哥夺冠
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队
致法拉利车迷。来自马拉内罗及更远地方的最新法拉利F1新闻、车手动态、技术分析与比赛反应。
在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道取得令人印象深刻的胜利后，马克斯·维斯塔潘表示，如果他是法拉利车队领队，他绝不会把两位一号车手放在一起。他认为刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔之间的争斗送给了他墨西哥站的胜利。
在墨西哥城大奖赛的首圈，法拉利两位车手激烈争夺，维斯塔潘利用这次冲突获益，赢下比赛，汉密尔顿在受罚后获得第二，勒克莱尔第四。
在圣保罗大奖赛周末期间接受Viaplay采访时，这位荷兰车手表示这种情况本可以避免。
“我以前就说过，很多人常常不同意，但如果我是车队领队，我绝不会要两位一号车手，因为那样就会出现这种事，”他说。
“一个不会为另一个让步，因为两人都认为自己能赢，我也是这样。如果我是车队领队，我会改变这一点。”
他补充说，法拉利如果有明确的一号车手和二号车手顺序，本会更好。
“如果你有明确的一号和二号车手，他们会在第一个弯角以P1和P2通过，并以那样的名次完赛。或者P1和P3，那也没问题，因为作为车队你仍然能拿到很棒的积分。”
法拉利一直确认两位车手可以自由竞争。在车队经历了一个戏剧性的周末后，领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔与两位车手开了会。他向媒体确认，会上他们“把问题解决了”。
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
法拉利在英特拉格斯赛道仅收获六个积分，勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿分别获得第八名和第九名。车队在积分榜上仍排名第二，领先红牛95分，本赛季还剩三场比赛。
瓦塞尔在赛道接受采访时表示：“我们昨晚开了会，因为两场比赛之间我得飞回欧洲，但会议进行得很顺利。
“能坐下来讨论是好事，澄清我的立场和他们的立场也是好事。这样做很好，现在我们把这一页翻过去，专注于下一场比赛。”
“指导原则仍然不变。他们或许积累了一些挫败感，因为每个周末都并排起步，事实不断累积。但归根结底，指导原则始终如一。
“他们需要彼此尊重，他们当然是两名有战斗精神的车手，但必须尊重对方，而首先且主要的是，他们需要尊重品牌、车队、在家工作的人以及在赛道工作的人。我认为我们在这方面投入了大量精力，传达的信息很明确，并将继续保持明确。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen questions Ferrari’s decision to let Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc race freely
The Red Bull driver believes Ferrari’s opening-lap battle allowed him to win in Mexico
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

Following his impressive win at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, Max Verstappen said he would never put two number one drivers together if he were a team principal of Ferrari. He believes the battle between Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc gifted him the win in Mexico.

The Ferrari pair fought hard on the opening lap at the Mexico City Grand Prix, and Verstappen took advantage of the clash, winning the race, with Hamilton second and Leclerc fourth after a time penalty.
Asked about it by Viaplay during the Sao Paulo Grand Prix weekend, the Dutchman said the situation could have been avoided.
"I've said it before, and a lot of people often don't agree, but if I was a team principal, I'd never get two number one drivers because then you get things like this," he said.
"One won't yield for the other because they both think they can win, and that's how I am too. And if I was a team principal, I'd change this."
He added that Ferrari would have been better served with a clear pecking order.

"If you had a clear number one and number two, they would've gone through the first corner as P1 and P2 and finished like that. Or P1 and P3, that's fine too, because as a team you're still scoring great points."

Ferrari has consistently confirmed that both drivers are free to race each other. Following what became a dramatic weekend for the Scuderia, team chief Fred Vasseur held a meeting with his two drivers. He confirmed to the media that during this, they had "squashed it".
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

Ferrari came away from Interlagos with just six points, as Leclerc and Hamilton finished eighth and ninth. The team is still second in the standings, 95 points ahead of Red Bull, with three races left.
Speaking at the circuit, Vasseur said: “We did [the meeting] yesterday evening because I had to fly back to Europe between the two races, but it went well.
“It was good to discuss, good to clarify my position and their position. It was good to do and now we turn the page and we are focused on the next one.

“The guidelines is still the same. They accumulated perhaps a bit of frustration because they are starting each weekend side-by-side and you have a kind of accumulation of fact. But at the end of the day, the guidelines is always the same.

“They need to respect each other, they are two competitors with the fighting spirit for sure, but they need to have respect for the other one, but mainly and firstly, they need to respect the brand, the team, the people working at home, the people working on track. I think we are putting a lot of effort on this, and the message was clear and will stay clear.”

items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton loses most marketable athlete crown as Charles Leclerc moves ahead
detailZh: 汉密尔顿失去最具市场价值运动员称号，勒克莱尔超越
SportsPro的2026年排名中，汉密尔顿从第一降至第二十二位，而他的法拉利队友现在成为了排名最高的F1车手，位列第九。
对于法拉利车迷来说，这里是Scuderia 法拉利 F1的最新消息，包括车手更新、技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应。
汉密尔顿在体育市场价值排名中失去榜首位置，被自己的法拉利队友勒克莱尔超越。
七次世界冠军去年位居SportsPro年度50位最具市场价值运动员榜首，但在2026年版中降至第22位，该榜单是根据NorthStar Solutions Group的数据制作的。
白俄罗斯网球明星阿莉娜·萨巴伦卡位居榜首，领先自由式滑雪运动员谷爱凌、篮球明星扬尼斯·安特托昆博、足球运动员埃尔林·哈兰德和网球运动员卡洛斯·阿尔卡拉斯。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔现在是排名最高的F1车手，从去年的第25位上升到第9位。汉密尔顿的得分从去年的96.03降至66.63，落后于勒克莱尔的71.12。
马克斯·维斯塔潘是唯一一位进入前50名的另一位F1车手，他从第81位攀升至第48位。
超越前50名，看到前100名，名单上出现了一些令人惊讶的名字。奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂排名56位，有趣的是，他超过了他的麦凯轮车队队友、2025年冠军兰多·诺里斯，诺里斯的排名从第41位下降到了第78位。基米·安东内利，F1的新世界冠军，勉强挤进了前150名，排名第126位。
正如你所想象的那样，这些分数是由品牌价值、势头和商业增长空间构建的。它们涵盖了从2025年7月1日到2026年6月30日的这段时间。这意味着本月早些时候安东内利在墨西哥的冠军头衔根本不包括在内。
这也意味着排名涵盖了汉密尔顿在法拉利艰难的第一个赛季的大部分时间。在那个时间段内，他未能完成大奖赛领奖台。他今年的赛季则是一个完全不同的故事，他在许多早期比赛中都坐在车手积分榜的第二位。在还剩下三场比赛的情况下，他目前排名第四，仍然在争夺第二名的位置。
这位英国人仍然排在大多数车手之上，他的品牌影响力远不止赛车，从时尚到电影。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton loses most marketable athlete crown as Charles Leclerc moves ahead
SportsPro's 2026 rankings have Hamilton down from first to 22nd, with his Ferrari team-mate now the highest-placed F1 driver in ninth
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Lewis Hamilton has lost his place at the top of sport's marketability rankings, and has slipped behind his own Ferrari team-mate too.

The seven-time world champion topped SportsPro's annual list of the 50 Most Marketable Athletes last year, but has dropped to 22nd in the 2026 edition, which was created with data from NorthStar Solutions Group.

Aryna Sabalenka, the Belarusian tennis star, sits at the very top of the list ahead of freestyle skier Eileen Gu, basketball star Giannis Antetokounmpo, footballer Erling Haaland and tennis player Carlos Alcaraz.

Charles Leclerc is now the highest-ranked F1 driver, in ninth after he sat at 25th last year. Hamilton's score has dropped to 66.63 out of 100, from 96.03 last year, leaving him behind Leclerc on 71.12.
Max Verstappen is the only other F1 driver in the top 50, having climbed from 81st to 48th.

Looking beyond the top 50 to the top 100 adds some surprising names to the list. Oscar Piastri is 56th, interestingly ahead of McLaren team-mate and 2025 champion Lando Norris, who has dropped from 41st to 78th. Kimi Antonelli, F1's new world champion, only scrapes into the top 150 in 126th.

As you would imagine, these scores are built from brand equity, momentum and room for commercial growth. They cover the period from 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026. That means Antonelli's title in Mexico earlier this month is not included at all.

It also means the rankings cover much of Hamilton's difficult first season at Ferrari. In that time period, he failed to finish on the podium for a grand prix. His season this year has been a very different story, with him sat second in the drivers' standings for many of the early races. With three races to go, he sits fourth and still in the fight for second place.
The Briton still ranks well above most of the grid, and his brand stretches far beyond just the racing, from fashion to film.

安东内利履行了他的承诺。梅赛德斯的新世界冠军本周以意大利国旗的颜色——绿色、白色和红色染发，出现在车队位于布拉克利的工厂，随着车队在总部庆祝其成功的赛季。
梅赛德斯在周三通过社交媒体发布了一段视频，展示了安东内利与车队成员见面时的场景，他和Toto Wolff以及拉塞尔都笑着欣赏他的新造型。
梅赛德斯在帖文中写道：“基米做到了。他真的做到了。”
安东内利在赛季初就承诺要染发。在圣保罗大奖赛之前，他告诉《La Gazzetta dello Sport》他肯定会这么做，只是不确定什么时候。
“我有了染发剂！现在我只是要决定是这周末做还是等到下周我前往布拉克利工厂并在所有员工面前发言时再做。带着染了色的头发去那里会很有趣。”
他选择了Brackley，在那里他和车队享受了一个没有比赛的星期，有很多值得庆祝的事情。安东内利在墨西哥赢得了车手冠军，当时还有四场比赛尚未进行，成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军，也是自1953年阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里以来意大利的第一个世界冠军。本赛季他总共赢得了九场大奖赛——这是他在锦标赛中的第二次夺冠。
梅赛德斯在周日于Interlagos锁定了制造商冠军，这是自2021年以来的第一次，尽管安东内利的比赛颇具挑战性。他在切换到干胎后发生打滑，最终排名第五。这是本赛季第一次梅赛德斯车队没有在领奖台上结束的比赛。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli keeps F1 title promise with Italian flag hair at Mercedes factory
The new world champion turned up at Brackley with green, white and red hair as Mercedes celebrated its title double with staff
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Kimi Antonelli has kept his word. Mercedes' new world champion arrived at the team's Brackley factory this week with his hair dyed green, white and red, the colours of the Italian flag, as the team celebrated its successful season at its headquarters.

Mercedes posted a video of the moment on social media on Wednesday, showing Antonelli meeting members of the team to laughter, with Toto Wolff and George Russell alongside him also laughing at his new look.
"Kimi did it. He actually did it," Mercedes wrote on the post.
Antonelli had promised to dye his hair earlier in the season. Before the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, he told La Gazzetta dello Sport that he was definitely going to do it, just not sure about when.

"I've got the cans! Now I just have to decide whether to do it this weekend or maybe wait until next week when I go to the factory in Brackley and have to speak in front of all the employees," he said. "It would be fun to turn up there with dyed hair."

He chose Brackley, where he and the team were enjoying a week without a race with plenty to celebrate. Antonelli clinched the drivers' championship in Mexico with four races still to go, becoming F1's youngest world champion at 20, and Italy's first since Alberto Ascari in 1953. He has won a total of nine grands prix this season - his second in the championship.

Mercedes then sealed the constructors' title at Interlagos on Sunday, its first since 2021, though Antonelli's own race was a challenging one. He spun out of the lead after the switch to slick tyres and finished fifth. This was the first race of the season where a Mercedes didn't finish on the podium.

detailZh: 梅赛德斯解释安东内利在英特拉格斯代价高昂的打滑背后的“异常”赛车表现
梅赛德斯F1车队说明了安东内利在巴西大奖赛中操控困难的原因
梅赛德斯副车队领队布拉德利·洛德解释了车队在F1巴西大奖赛中多次打滑的原因。
在墨西哥确认首个年度冠军后的首场比赛中，安东内利原本有望利用杆位得主兰多·诺里斯的糟糕起步，从第二位发车抢得领先，并在湿干湿交替的比赛中前15圈建立了舒适的领先优势。
但在第18圈，由于诺里斯在前一圈进站，安东内利从磨损的中性胎换成干地胎后，开始报告令人困惑的悬挂问题，感觉他的W17赛车向一侧跑偏。两圈后，安东内利在1号弯冲出赛道，赛车尾部在刹车时突然失控，将他甩入缓冲区。
这位意大利车手重新回到比赛，但将领先位置输给了诺里斯，并在排名中进一步下滑，最终以第五名完赛，落后诺里斯41秒。安东内利的打滑并非孤立事件，他此前已在湿滑的12号弯冲出赛道。与此同时，队友乔治·拉塞尔在狭窄的维修区出口打滑后幸运地逃过一劫，他奋力追赶，最终以第四名完赛，排在安东内利之前。
“打滑这件事我需要仔细看看，因为我也不知道为什么车尾会这么快失控，”安东内利在梅赛德斯锁定车队总冠军后，对自己糟糕比赛的愤怒有所平息，他说道。“毫无预警，什么都没有。但当我换上软胎时，我就感觉赛车有些奇怪。所以，我们需要检查发生了什么，但另一方面，很遗憾，因为我们就是在那里输掉了比赛。”
梅赛德斯锁定了自2021年以来的首个车队总冠军
在调查了两位车手所遇到的操控问题后，梅赛德斯认为，他们报告的操控异常主要归因于在周日较冷条件下让轮胎进入正确工作窗口的困难。
“基米显然打滑了，四个轮胎都出现了平斑，所以他的速度受到了一定限制，”洛德在车队的社交媒体复盘中说。“当我们换上干地软胎时确实非常挣扎，在最后一段进站间隔也是如此，赛车非常非常难开，转向过度严重，尤其是在软胎阶段，轮胎温度非常低。
“这意味着两位车手，实际上还有场上的其他车手，都以为赛车出了什么故障。但仔细看，看起来我们只是低于轮胎温度窗口，有时会短暂进入窗口，但在潮湿条件下又会掉出来，这就是导致赛车行为非常奇怪和异常的原因。”
洛德补充说：“这是一场真正跌宕起伏的比赛。很少会出现这样的情况：你在编队圈打滑并几乎撞上护栏，另一辆车在维修区打滑，赛道上还发生了几起事故，尽管如此还是设法以第四和第五名完赛。
“在巴西站的比赛中，有几个阶段——起步时使用第一套半雨胎，以及随后在干地上使用软胎的长时间阶段——我们实际上是赛道上最快的赛车。”
detailEn: Mercedes explains "unusual" car behaviour behind Kimi Antonelli's costly Interlagos spin
The Mercedes Formula 1 team offers reasons behind Kimi Antonelli's handling difficulties in the Brazilian Grand Prix
Mercedes deputy team principal Bradley Lord has provided an explanation for several spins that occurred for the Silver Arrows in Formula 1's Brazilian Grand Prix.

In his first event since his maiden title was confirmed in Mexico, Kimi Antonelli looked set to capitalise on a poor start by polesitter Lando Norris to snatch the lead from second on the grid, building up a comfortable buffer over the first 15 laps of a wet-dry-wet race.

But after changing from worn intermediates to slicks on lap 18, in response to Norris' stop one lap prior, Antonelli began reporting puzzling suspension issues, feeling like his W17 was pulling to one side. Two laps later Antonelli went off in Turn 1 as his car's rear end suddenly snapped under braking, spitting Antonelli out into the run-off area.

The Italian recovered but lost the lead to Norris and dropped further down the order to finish fifth, 41 seconds behind Norris. Antonelli's spin didn't come in isolation, as he had already gone off at the slippery Turn 12. Meanwhile, team-mate George Russell was fortunate to survive a spin at the narrow pit exit as he rallied to finish ahead of Antonelli in fourth.

"The spin is something I need to look at because I don't know why I lost the rear so quickly as well," Antonelli said after his anger over his poor race had subsided thanks to Mercedes clinching the constructors' title. "Like no warning, nothing. But already when I put on the softs, I felt something weird with the car. So, we need to check what happened but on the other hand yeah, shame because we lost the race there."
Mercedes clinched its first constructors' title since 2021

After investigating the handling issues both of its drivers experienced, Mercedes believes the handling anomalies they reported were largely down to the difficulties getting the tyres into the right operating window in Sunday's cooler conditions.

"Kimi obviously had had a spin, flat-spotted all four tyres and so his pace was somewhat limited," said Lord in the team's social media debrief. "We did really struggle as we went onto that dry soft tyre and then in the final inter-stint as well, with a car that was very, very tricky to drive, very oversteery and in the soft tyre stint in particular, with very low tyre temperatures.

"That meant both of the drivers, and indeed other drivers in the field, actually thought there was something broken with the car. But looking at it, it looked like we were just below the tyre temperature window, sometimes popping into it, but then dropping back out of it in the damp conditions, and that's what was causing the very strange and unusual car behaviour."

Lord added: "It was a really topsy-turvy race. It's not very often that you spin off on a formation lap and almost make contact with a barrier, that you spin in the pitlane with the other car, that you have several incidents on track as well and nonetheless manage to come home fourth and fifth.
"There were periods of the race in Brazil, the first inter tyre at the start and then during a large part of that dry soft-tyre stint, that we actually were the fastest car on track."

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿2026年失去‘最具市场价值运动员’称号
items.summaryZh: 汉密尔顿不再是体育界最具市场价值的运动员，甚至不再是最具市场价值的F1车手，因为他在最新由媒体和活动公司SportsPro发布的排名中落后于法拉利队友勒克莱尔。汉密尔顿在2025年SportsPro市场价值排名中位居第一，总市场价值得分为96.03分。2026年，汉密尔顿排名22位，市场价值得分为66.63分，与足球运动员内马尔和维尼修斯·儒尼奥尔相当。
items.originalTitle: Hamilton loses 'most marketable athlete' status in 2026
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿不再是体育界最具市场价值的运动员——甚至不再是最具市场价值的F1车手，因为在由媒体和活动公司SportsPro发布的最新排名中，他落后于法拉利车队队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔。
汉密尔顿在2025年SportsPro运动员市场价值排名中位居第一，总市场价值得分为96.03分（满分100分）。
2026年，汉密尔顿排名22位。他的市场价值得分为66.63分，与足球运动员内马尔和维尼修斯·若纳尔并列。
汉密尔顿的队友勒克莱尔在榜单上领先，排名第9，市场价值得分为71.12分，比2025年榜单上的第25位，得分为75.03分有所上升。
下一位最高的车手是马克斯·维斯塔潘（第48位，去年排名第81位），而2025年冠军兰多·诺里斯（第78位）现在排名在麦凯轮车队队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂（第56位）之后，去年他领先23位排在第41位。
新冠军基米·安东内利是排名最低的F1车手，他在第126位进入前150名，比2025年的第78位下降了48位。
MotoGP骑手马克·马奎兹是唯一一个未与F1挂钩的赛车运动运动员，排名第86位，比阿尔卑斯F1车手皮埃尔·加斯利高5位。
白俄罗斯网球运动员阿莉娜·萨巴伦卡位居榜首，领先中国滑雪运动员谷爱凌、希腊篮球运动员吉安尼斯·安特托昆博、挪威足球运动员埃尔林·哈兰德和西班牙网球运动员卡洛斯·阿尔卡拉斯。
美国运动员占据了前150名的32%，而英国和印度运动员各占7.3%的份额。
足球（足球）有33名运动员上榜，占据了22%的份额，而赛车运动的8位代表（5.3%）将其排在第六位，排在网球和板球之后，但领先于高尔夫和拳击。
NASCAR女车手托尼·布赖丁格和F1车手利亚姆·劳森从榜单上退下，此前他们在2025年曾上榜。
市场推广评分是如何计算的——为什么汉密尔顿的评分低于勒克莱尔？
市场可及性评分是品牌价值、势头和商业轨迹三个指标的组合，这三个指标是通过结合“数百个数据点”以及截至2025年7月1日和2026年6月30日超过3000个品牌合作记录来计算的。
向下滚动查看赛车运动运动员在排名前150位中的位置。
品牌价值是运动员品牌的强度和信任度，势头是运动员价值增长的速率，商业轨迹是运动员未来商业增长的潜力。
在这三个指标中，最后一个指标（商业轨迹）的权重最小，分数是相对的而不是绝对的；萨巴连卡（Sabalenka）的排名是在考虑其他运动员的情况下确定的。
勒克莱尔，29岁，品牌价值评分高于汉密尔顿，但动力评分较低。这位摩纳哥人的商业轨迹排名也提升了他的排名，与汉密尔顿相比有所提升。
年龄和运动生涯的持久性对轨迹评分有影响：41岁的汉密尔顿与克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多和勒布朗·詹姆斯并列成为名单上最年长的运动员。
此外，勒克莱尔在商业轨迹指标上得分很高，这意味着他的品牌力量尚未转化为与汉密尔顿相比的商业回报。
勒克莱尔在品牌价值上得分高，这得益于他个人的风格和公众形象，以及他受众的规模和受众如何积极地与他品牌互动。
克里斯·柯林斯，排名系统提供方的总裁对BlackBook Motorsport表示，勒克莱尔拥有世界上任何运动员中最强大的品牌之一。
他在我们评估的247名运动员中品牌价值排名第二，这建立在如何展示自己、引人入胜的个人故事以及持续选择与他合作的优质合作伙伴的基础上。
作为赛车场上最受关注的驾驶员之一，他的观众评分表现良好并不令人意外，这也强调了他的粉丝积极与他互动。他还受益于高观众覆盖度评分，这对于所有拥有全球形象的F1车手来说是预期结果。
他还补充说，汉密尔顿排名不在前十的原因不是他的品牌，而是时间。41岁的他自然在职业生涯的前景上有所减少，前瞻性的评估应该会在他职业生涯的后期章节中看到一段伟大的职业生涯。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton is no longer sport’s most marketable athlete - or even the most marketable Formula 1 driver, having fallen behind Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc - in the latest rankings created by media and events business SportsPro.
Hamilton was top of the 2025 SportsPro marketability rankings for athletes, with a total marketability score of 96.03 out of 100.
In 2026, Hamilton is ranked 22nd. His marketability score is 66.63, on par with footballers Neymar and Vinicius Junior.
Hamilton’s team-mate Leclerc is ahead in ninth on the list with a marketability score of 71.12, up from 25th in the 2025 list with a score of 75.03.

The next-highest driver is Max Verstappen (48th, up from 81st last year), while 2025 champion Lando Norris (78th) is now ranked behind McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri (56th) having been 23 places ahead in 41st last year.
New champion Kimi Antonelli is the lowest placed F1 driver who made the top 150 in 126th, a 48-place drop from 78th in 2025.
MotoGP rider Marc Marquez is the only motorsport athlete not tied to F1 on the list, ranking 86th, five places above Alpine F1 driver Pierre Gasly.

Belarusian tennis player Aryna Sabalenka is top of the list with, ahead of Chinese skier Eileen Gu, Greek basketball player Giannis Antetokounmpo, Norwegian footballer Erling Haaland, and Spanish tennis player Carlos Alcaraz.
American athletes make up 32% of the top 150 while British and Indian athletes are next with 7.3% of the pie apiece.

Football (soccer) has 33 athletes on the list and a 22% share of the list while motorsport’s eight representatives (5.3%) put it sixth on the list of sports, behind tennis and cricket but ahead of golf and boxing.
Female NASCAR driver Toni Breidinger and F1 driver Liam Lawson dropped off the list having appeared in 2025.
How the marketability scores are calculated - why is Hamilton lower than Leclerc?

The marketability score is a combination of brand equity, momentum, and commercial trajectory, three metrics that are calculated by combining "several hundred data points" and more than 3000 brand partnership records over July 1, 2025, and June 30, 2026.
Scroll down to see how the motorsport athletes rank within the top 150.

Brand equity is the strength and trust of the athlete’s brand, momentum is the rate at which the athlete’s value is growing, and commercial trajectory is the room for an athlete’s future commercial growth.
The latter metric is given the smallest weighting out of the three, and the scores are relative rather than absolute; Sabalenka’s ranking puts her top with the other athletes in mind.
Leclerc, 29, has a higher brand equity score than Hamilton but a lower momentum score. The Monegasque’s ranking of commercial trajectory also boosts his ranking compared to Hamilton.
Age and longevity in the sport has an impact on the trajectory score: at 41 Hamilton is the joint-oldest athlete on the list with Cristiano Ronaldo and LeBron James.
Furthermore, Leclerc scores highly on the commercial trajectory metric, implying that there is strength in his brand that hasn’t been converted into commercial returns compared to Hamilton.
Leclerc scores high in brand equity due to his personal style and public presentation, plus the size of his audience and how actively that audience engages with his brand.
Chris Collins, president of NorthStar (which powers the rankings) said to BlackBook Motorsport that Leclerc has "one of the strongest established brands of any athlete in the world.
"He ranks second of all 247 athletes we assessed on brand equity, built on how he presents himself, a compelling personal story and premium partners who keep choosing to work with him.

"As one of the most-followed drivers on the grid, it’s little surprise to see his audience scores performing well, but it also emphasises that his followers actively interact with his profile. He also benefits from a high audience breadth score, an expected outcome for all Formula 1 drivers thanks to their global profile."

He added of Hamilton: "What keeps him below the top 10 isn’t his brand, it’s time. At 41, there is naturally less career runway ahead, and a forward-looking assessment should read a great career in its later chapters exactly that way."

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen explains why he’s so good in the rain in Brazil
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen explained what gives him such racecraft in the rain in Sao Paulo after another remarkable drive at the Brazilian Grand Prix. Interlagos is among the tracks where he has his highest podium-finishing rate, with eight top-three results in 11 races.
detailZh: 维斯塔潘解释为何自己在巴西雨战中如此出色
英特拉格斯是维斯塔潘最擅长的赛道之一，尤其是当天空下起雨时
维斯塔潘在巴西大奖赛再次奉献一场精彩驾驶后，深入剖析了是什么让他在圣保罗的雨战中拥有如此出色的比赛能力。
在维斯塔潘职业生涯初期就已在赛历上的赛道中，他在英特拉格斯和奥斯汀的登台率最高，11场比赛中有8次进入前三。
其中三场是在若泽·卡洛斯·帕塞赛道（Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace）上演的雨中精彩驾驶。2016年，年仅18岁、二年级生的维斯塔潘在安全车带领七圈后绿旗终于挥动时，早在1号弯就找到了超越基米·莱科宁法拉利的方法；随后他在太阳弯（Curva do Sol）外侧对最终冠军尼科·罗斯伯格完成了一次精彩的外道超越。
马克斯·维斯塔潘对尼科·罗斯伯格的难忘超越
2024年，这位红牛车手从第15位起步，第一圈就提升了四个位置，一路劈开赛道上的车流，最终以19秒的优势领先埃斯特班·奥康夺冠。
最后，上周末，维斯塔潘发现自己排在发车格最后一排，位列第21位，但他在五圈之内一路拼杀升至第七；他最终获得第二名，落后比赛冠军兰多·诺里斯15秒——而且他实际上相信自己本可以做得更好。
“在前往发车格的几圈之后，我感觉相当有信心，”这位四届世界冠军解释道。“我出去跑了一下，心想‘哦，抓地力很低’。但后来我身边有几辆车，我就想‘不，我觉得我们实际上有很多抓地力’。
“在两圈之内，我几乎在每个弯道都飞速超过车辆。我想我们比中场大多数车手拥有更多的抓地力。我不知道我在第几圈进入了前十名，但这一切发生得非常快。
“我知道我们拥有的平衡就在那里，这在前几圈也体现出来了。不幸的是，在第一段 比赛阶段之后，那完全消失了，但幸运的是，至少在第一段 stint 中赛车运转良好，这让我能够处于这个位置。
“我们必须理解为什么或什么出了问题，当我们一换上干地轮胎时，因为即使我在最后换回半雨胎时，赛车与我的第一段 stint 相比天差地别，这表明有问题。”
因此，当被问及如何在湿滑赛道上相对其他车手找到机会时，维斯塔潘指出，英特拉格斯赛道的地势起伏和多条实用赛车线让这变得更容易——这在干燥条件下确实如此，但被雨水放大了。
“我对赛车感到舒适、有信心，只是努力在不同位置寻找抓地力，”他解释道。“然后赛车就在我前面，所以我试着超越他们。
“当然，这条赛道也允许你走不同的线路，我认为这很棒，因为它确实有助于比赛。无论干地还是湿地，这都是一条好赛道，这确实创造了更多超车机会。
“你需要在赛车中感觉良好。你需要感到舒适，才能可能多冒一点风险，而在这里这对我来说效果相当不错。”
维斯塔潘在最近三届巴西大奖赛中都是从第15位或更靠后的位置发车；尽管这让他完成了多达23次超车，并最终三次登上领奖台，包括前述的那场胜利，但这位荷兰车手还是希望在2027年能有一场更顺利的比赛。
“也许明年我更愿意从稍微靠前的位置发车，而不是从后排或维修区起步，但明年我们就知道了，”维斯塔潘说道，他如今已在2026年车手锦标赛中锁定亚军席位。
detailEn: Max Verstappen explains why he’s so good in the rain in Brazil
Interlagos is among Verstappen’s best tracks – especially when the skies open up
Max Verstappen has delved into what gives him such racecraft when it rains in Sao Paulo, after another remarkable drive in Formula 1’s Brazilian Grand Prix.
Among tracks that have been on the calendar since the beginning of his career, Verstappen has his highest podium-finishing rate at Interlagos – and Austin – with eight top-three results in 11 races.

Three of these were starring wet-weather drives at Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace. Back in 2016, as an 18-year-old sophomore, Verstappen found a way past Kimi Raikkonen’s Ferrari as early as Turn 1 when the green flag was finally waved after seven laps behind the safety car; he went on to perform a superb around-the-outside move on eventual champion Nico Rosberg in Curva do Sol.
Max Verstappen's memorable move on Nico Rosberg
In 2024, starting from 15th, the Red Bull driver gained four spots on lap one, scythed through the field and romped to victory, 19 seconds ahead of Esteban Ocon.

Finally, last weekend, Verstappen found himself on the back row on the grid, down in 21st, but he fought his way up to seventh in the space of five laps; he eventually finished second, 15 seconds adrift of race winner Lando Norris – and he actually believes he could have done even better.

“After the laps to the grid, I felt pretty confident,” the four-time world champion explained. “I went out and I was like, ‘Oh, low grip’. But then I actually had some cars around me and I was like, ‘No, I think we actually have a lot of grip’.

“Within two laps, I was just flying by cars, almost every corner. We had a lot more grip, I guess, than most in the midfield. I don't know what lap I was in the top 10, but it all happened very quickly.

“I knew that the balance we had was there, and that also showed in the first few laps. Unfortunately, that then completely disappeared after the first stint, but luckily at least in the first stint the car was working, and that allowed me to be in this position.

“We have to understand why or what went wrong with the car as soon as we went to the slick tyres, because even when I switched back to the Inter tyres at the end, the car was night and day different to my first stint, which shows that there is something wrong.”

So, when asked how he manages to find opportunities relative to other drivers on a wet track, Verstappen points out the Interlagos track makes it easier, with its elevation changes and various practical racing lines – which is true in dry conditions but magnified by the rain.
“I felt comfortable with the car, confident, just trying to find the grip in different places,” he explained. “Then the car is ahead of me, so I try to pass them.

“This track, of course, also allows you to do different lines, which I think is great because it really helps the racing. It's a good track in the dry and wet, and that really sets up more overtaking opportunities.
“You need to feel good in the car. You need to feel comfortable to be able to risk probably a little bit more, and it's been working for me quite well here.”

Verstappen has now started from 15th or lower in the last three Brazilian grands prix; even though those yielded a whopping 23 overtakes on his way to three podium finishes, including the aforementioned victory, the Dutchman would appreciate a more straightforward drive in 2027.

“Maybe next year I'd love to start a bit further up front instead of starting from the back or the pit lane, but we'll find out next year,” said Verstappen, who has now grabbed the runner-up spot in the 2026 drivers’ championship.

detailZh: 本田令人担忧的可靠性问题再度出现，其中包含一项新故障，其根源可能在F1赛季结束前都无法查明。
阿斯顿·马丁与引擎合作伙伴本田在巴西遭遇三连赛中的第三次退赛，兰斯·斯特罗尔连续第二场比赛退赛。
斯特罗尔在巴西大奖赛周末期间出现两次独立的电池问题，周日正赛未跑到半程即退赛。
这意味着斯特罗尔本赛季20场比赛仅完赛6场，而队友费尔南多·阿隆索则有7次退赛。
最近出现了一些乐观的迹象——相对而言，考虑到这个新联盟的首个赛季如此灾难性——阿隆索在五场比赛前的马来西亚站得分，在奥斯汀尽管首圈就遭受了严重的底板损伤却出人意料地拥有不错的速度，并在巴西的雨战中表现出色。
在那里，阿隆索轻松地为阿斯顿·马丁和本田带来了他们今年最好的排位赛表现，首次进入Q3并以第八位发车。
但这一点被严重削弱了，因为显著的脆弱性重新出现，这更接近本田2026年初糟糕的开局状态。
可靠性问题也断送了阿隆索在墨西哥的机会，在那里他看起来相当有竞争力，比平时更接近前十。这个问题与能量回收系统内部的冷却系统有关，而在巴西，斯特罗尔出现的电池问题敲响了明确的警钟。
本田首席赛道工程师折原慎太郎承认，“我们知道发生了什么，但不知道根本原因是什么”。
他承认找到根本原因可能需要几周时间，但根据现有数据，已经需要为下一站拉斯维加斯站采取某种应对措施，同时本田正在追查深层原因，以便在2027年妥善解决。
“我们需要为明年找到这个错误的真正根本原因，”他说。
“否则，我们会一直遇到同样的问题。”
这次故障与墨西哥站发生的情况不同，墨西哥站的问题导致了MGU-K故障。但主题是相似的：在墨西哥，折原承认本田引擎在不止一个方面缺乏稳健性，而那里的故障在模拟中并未显现。
现在本田知道发生了什么，但不知道为什么。这是两个问题之间令人担忧的贯穿线。这也让人回想起赛季初，当时本田能够识别出现问题的明显灾难性后果，并能大致看出问题来自哪里，但不知道问题的确切根源，因为与它在测功机上经历的情况相比，这个问题是突然出现的。
特别令人担忧的是，这似乎确实是本田在赛季中期达到的水平的一种倒退。
其性能显然仍然不足，而且即使全年通过升级试图缩小差距，其引擎在内燃机方面仍然动力不足。
但至少已经发展到了这样一个阶段：赛车能够完成比赛，这使得阿隆索在阿斯顿·马丁赛车大幅升级时能够获得一些积分。
在夏休期前后，阿隆索连续五场完赛，而斯特罗尔也在夏休期前的三场比赛中取得了今年六次完赛中的两次。
折原承认，可靠性在赛季中期确实更好，但最近几场比赛中，这已被“几个问题”所取代。
这一趋势的部分原因可能与部件的里程数有关——部件只是到了其使用寿命周期的终点——或者只是本田为了性能而更用力地运行引擎并超出了极限。
但就巴西站具体出现的电池问题而言，现在判断触发原因还为时过早。
本田本赛季在发动机综合性能方面并未取得所期望的进展，充其量只是在非常特定的情况下实现了部分性能目标。
因此，可靠性变差却没有明显收益，这让本田承受压力，并在其不得不克服诸多逆境的一年即将结束之际，再次招致不幸的大量负面审视。
这也给本田正在进行的2027年研发工作带来了变数，届时它需要在性能和可靠性两方面都迈进一步。
到目前为止所表明的一切是，新赛季开始时不会有一个重大升级。已经有一个在全年分阶段引入进一步升级的计划。但这项工作已经深入进行中。
故障排查会占用人力资源、在F1引擎开发限制下受限的台架测试时间、受引擎成本上限约束的资金，以及单纯的时间，因为距离2027年初的时钟正在滴答作响。
首先是墨西哥的冷却问题，无论那究竟是什么，现在是电池方面的这个问题，使本田的注意力偏离了一条它理想情况下本应走得更远的道路。
本田首席执行官三部敏宏在巴西，折原表示这对员工有激励作用——“但另一方面，我们本周末两次遇到电池问题”。
这并不完全是本田F1部门希望在大老板面前展示自己的方式。但正如折原所指出的，三部至少“了解赛道边正在发生什么”。
“他会把这种经验带到日本方面，也会促进我们的研发，”折原说。
如果曾经有任何可能，让人对本田为达到必要标准还需做多少工作而产生自满情绪，那么这位首席执行官亲眼看到2026年已如此深入时仍会遇到的那类问题，就会把这种情绪彻底消除。
detailEn: Honda's worrying return of reliability problems includes a new issue, the root cause of which it might not trace before the end of the Formula 1 season.
Aston Martin and engine partner Honda suffered their third DNF of the triple-header in Brazil, when Lance Stroll retired for the second race in a row.
Stroll had two separate battery problems over the course of the Brazil weekend and didn't make it to mid-distance in Sunday's grand prix.
It means Stroll has finished just six of the 20 races held this season, while team-mate Fernando Alonso has had seven retirements of his own.

There have been some flashes of optimism - in relative terms, given how disastrous this first season of the new alliance has been - of late as Alonso scored points in Malaysia five races ago, had surprisingly good pace at Austin despite sustaining significant floor damage on the opening lap, and excelled in the wet in Brazil.
There, Alonso comfortably gave Aston Martin and Honda their best qualifying of the year, getting into Q3 for the first time and lining up eighth on the grid.
But this has been badly undercut by a return of significant fragility that's closer to how badly Honda started 2026.

Reliability problems also put paid to Alonso's chances in Mexico, where he had looked quite competitive and closer to the top 10 than normal. The issue was related to the cooling system inside the energy recovery system, whereas in Brazil the emergence of battery problems for Stroll sounded a clear alarm bell.
Shintaro Orihara, Honda's lead trackside engineer, acknowledged that "we know what happened, but we don't know what is the root cause".

He admitted it may take a few weeks to find that, but already from the data there needs to be some kind of countermeasure for the next race in Las Vegas, while Honda traces the underlying cause so it can be addressed properly for 2027.
"We need to find the actual root cause of this error for next year," he said.
"Otherwise, we keep having the same issue."

This was a different kind of failure to what had occurred in Mexico, which had led to MGU-K problems. But the theme is similar: in Mexico, Orihara had admitted to a lack of robustness within Honda's engine in more ways than one, and the fault there hadn't shown up in simulation.

Now Honda knows what happened but doesn't know why. That's a worrying through-line between the two issues. It also harks back to the start of the year, when Honda could identify the obvious catastrophic consequences of the problems that were emerging and could see broadly where they came from, but didn't know exactly what the problem's root was, because it had come out of the blue compared with what it had experienced on the dyno.
What's particularly alarming is that this does seem to be a regression from where Honda had got to in the middle of the season.
Its performance was obviously still lacking, and its engine is still underpowered on the internal combustion side, even with upgrades through the year to try to trim the deficit.
But it had at least got to a point where its cars were finishing races, which allowed Alonso to score some points when the Aston Martin was heavily upgraded.
Either side of the summer break, Alonso had five straight finishes, and Stroll got two of his six finishes this year in three races before the summer break too.
Orihara acknowledged that reliability was simply better in the middle of the season, but that has been replaced by "several issues" in recent races.

Some of this trend could be related to the mileage of parts - components simply coming to the end of their life cycle - or to just a case of Honda trying to run the engine harder for performance and going over the edge.
But with the battery issue that emerged in Brazil specifically, it's too early to say what the trigger was.

Honda has not made the progress it would have hoped for this season in terms of the all-round performance of the engine, and at best has only achieved some of its performance targets in very specific circumstances.

So the fact that reliability has got worse, without a clear upside, puts Honda under pressure and brings an unfortunate amount of negative scrutiny again, right at the end of a year in which it has had to come through quite a lot of adversity.
It is also a curveball for the development work Honda is doing on 2027, when it needs to take a step in both performance and reliability.

Everything that has been indicated so far is that there will not be a major step at the start of the new season. There's already a plan to phase in further upgrades through the year. But that work will already be deeply under way.

Troubleshooting takes away human resource, limited dyno hours which are restricted under F1's engine development limits, money that comes under the engine cost cap, and simply time because the clock is ticking to the start of 2027.
First the cooling issue in Mexico, whatever that was exactly, and now this on the battery side, takes Honda's focus away from a path that it would ideally be a lot further down.
Honda CEO Toshihiro Mibe was in Brazil, which Orihara said has a galvanising effect on the staff - "but on the other hand, we had a battery issue twice this weekend".
It was not exactly how Honda's F1 operation would have liked to present itself in front of the big boss. But, as Orihara noted, Mibe at least "knows what is happening trackside".
"He will bring this experience to the Japanese side and also boost our development," said Orihara.

If there was ever any possibility of complacency creeping in about how much work Honda has to do to reach the necessary standard, the CEO seeing first-hand the kind of problems still being encountered this deep into 2026 will have stamped it out.

items.summaryEn: McLaren team principal Andrea Stella said Las Vegas has historically been the team's toughest race and that he hopes the team can "finally" make peace with it this time. He heads to Las Vegas with optimism after Lando Norris's win at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.

这位迈凯伦领队表示，拉斯维加斯大概是车队最艰难的一站，但在兰多·诺里斯于巴西夺冠后，他带着一些乐观情绪前往那里

安德烈亚·斯特拉表示，迈凯伦正力争“终于”与历史上对车队而言颇为艰难的拉斯维加斯站和解。
圣保罗大奖赛对迈凯伦来说是一个成功的周末，兰多·诺里斯以本赛季第三场胜利展现出统治级的表现，队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在速度上也有强劲的提升。
拉斯维加斯对车队来说通常是截然不同的挑战，这条赛道以内华达州深夜的低温为特点。但迈凯伦很享受巴西站提供的寒冷潮湿周末，MCL40能够控制其轮胎温度。
车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉相信，车队重返美国可能会收获大量积分。
“拉斯维加斯是一条非常不同的赛道布局。长直道，”他说。“我们在蒙扎见过这种情况，我们在巴库也见过，当要求是提升极速时，迈凯伦不一定是最好的赛车。
“我们知道，这也在某种程度上与我们的传动比有关，当你需要超过某个最高速度水平时，这些传动比并不理想。但话虽如此，我认为我们带着一些乐观情绪前往拉斯维加斯，因为赛车现在更快了。”
自夏季以来，速度提升来自多项升级，包括在巴西引入的新前翼，迈凯伦设计它是为了让赛车更可预测。斯特拉确认，更多新部件将抵达拉斯维加斯。
“这些升级将得到一些抵达拉斯维加斯的新部件的补充，它们构成了明年赛车的基础，”他说。
去年，诺里斯和皮亚斯特里在拉斯维加斯分别获得第二和第四，但两辆赛车都因底板下方滑块的过度磨损而被取消资格。
他说：“我们想去那里取得好成绩，因为这在全年赛历的所有比赛中，可能是我们最挣扎的一站。即便去年我们有一场不错的比赛，我们也因为底板磨损的问题把自己的处境搞得很糟。”
“所以我们期待去拉斯维加斯，在那里取得好成绩，最终与这条赛道和解。”
迈凯伦在车队积分榜上排名第四，在仅剩三站的情况下落后红牛17分。这支木瓜色涂装的车队在拉斯维加斯大道霓虹灯下承受着拿大分的压力，以在漫长赛季后拿下第三名。
detailEn: Andrea Stella wants McLaren to "finally" make peace with Las Vegas
McLaren's team principal says Las Vegas has probably been the team's toughest race, but he is heading there with some optimism after Lando Norris's win in Brazil
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.
Andrea Stella says McLaren is aiming to finally make "peace" with what has historically been a difficult race for the team in Las Vegas.

The Sao Paulo Grand Prix was a successful weekend for McLaren, with Lando Norris showing a dominant level of performance with his third win of the season, and team-mate Oscar Piastri showing a strong uptick in pace.

Las Vegas is usually a very different beast for teams, with the circuit boasting the cold temperatures of a late evening in Nevada. But McLaren enjoyed the cold and wet weekend Brazil offered, with the MCL40 being able to control its tyre temperatures.
Team principal Andrea Stella believes the team's return to the United States could yield a strong haul of points.

"It's a very different circuit layout, Vegas. Long straights," he said. "We have seen this in Monza, we have seen this in Baku, that when the requirement is to develop top speed, not necessarily McLaren is the best car.

"We know that this also somehow relates to our gear ratios that are not ideal when you need to go above a certain level of top speed. But having said that, I think we approach Vegas with some optimism because the car is faster now."

The pace has come from several upgrades since the summer, including a new front wing in Brazil that McLaren designed to make the car more predictable. Stella confirmed that more new parts would arrive in Las Vegas.
"These upgrades, they will be complemented by some more parts that come in Vegas, and they form the foundation for what will be next year's car," he said.
Last year, Norris and Piastri finished second and fourth in Vegas, only for both cars to be disqualified for excessive wear on the skid blocks under the floor.

"We want to go there and have a good result because it's been probably, of all the races in the calendar, the one that we've been struggling the most," he said. "And even last year that we had a good race, we made our life bad with the problem that we had with the skid wear.
"So we look forward to Vegas, have a good result there and finally being in peace with this venue."

McLaren is fourth in the constructors' standings, 17 points behind Red Bull with just three races left. The papaya-coloured team is under pressure to score big under the neon lights of The Strip to finish third after what has been a long season.

items.summaryEn: McLaren driver Oscar Piastri says he misses the pressure of fighting for the Formula 1 world championship during what has been a difficult 2026 season.
detailZh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里承认，他“怀念”F1争冠战带来的压力。
这位迈凯伦车手去年曾是冠军争夺者，但如今他的重心是帮助车队在车队积分榜上击败红牛、拿到第三名。
致迈凯伦车迷。来自沃金的木瓜色新闻，包含车手、赛车、车队策略以及每个比赛周末的最新动态。
迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里表示，在艰难的2026赛季中，他怀念争夺F1世界冠军时的那种压力。
这位澳大利亚车手去年大部分时间都领跑车手积分榜，最终落后于队友兰多·诺里斯和红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘获得第三名。尽管去年错失了总冠军，但对皮亚斯特里来说，这是地面效应规则时代的成功收官。
然而今年并不属于他。目前他仅剩三场比赛，在积分榜上排名第七，且尚未赢得任何一场比赛。当被问及缺乏争冠机会是否对他造成打击时，他更愿意关注本赛季迄今为止的积极面。
“是也不是，”他说。“如果可能的话，我希望每年都能参与总冠军争夺，但今年确实轻松了一些。显然，我们并不想处于这个位置，但压力没有那么大。
“但争冠时的那种压力正是你想要的感觉，因为这意味着你在为你的目标而战。今年我肯定怀念那种感觉。”
迈凯伦一直难以匹配其在过去两个赛季F1新规则下所展现的速度，皮亚斯特里表示这辆车从一开始就很难驾驭。
“这辆车开起来并不那么容易，即使到现在也仍然不容易，”他说。“我们花了一段时间才准确理解需要改变什么，而真正去改变它又很困难。但我们正在慢慢取得进展。”
巴西站有一些迹象。周日，诺里斯在英特拉格斯获胜，迈凯伦为赛车升级了新的前翼，旨在让赛车更可预测，而皮亚斯特里在Q2被淘汰后追至第六。
皮亚斯特里现在有了另一个目标。迈凯伦在车队积分榜上排名第四，落后红牛17分，他在赛后表示，缩小这一差距是他本赛季剩余时间的首要任务。
他说：“继续学习，最终努力在车队锦标赛中击败红牛。这是最重要的事情。这肯定不是一件容易的事，但我认为这是可能的。我认为赛车这个周末向前迈进了一步，所以希望这能继续保持下去。”
皮亚斯特里还在周一确认，他已经与经纪人马克·韦伯分道扬镳。韦伯是前红牛车手，从皮亚斯特里的青训时期起就一直指导他的职业生涯。
他将在下周的拉斯维加斯获得下一次缩小与红牛差距的机会。
detailEn: Oscar Piastri admits he is "missing" the stress of an F1 title fight
The McLaren driver was a championship contender last year, but is now focused on helping his team beat Red Bull to third in the constructors' standings
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.
McLaren's Oscar Piastri is missing the pressure of fighting for the Formula 1 world championship amid what has been a difficult 2026 season.

The Australian led the drivers' standings for a lot of last year before he eventually finished third behind team-mate Lando Norris and Red Bull's Max Verstappen. Although he missed out on the championship last year, it was a successful end to the ground effect regulations for Piastri.

This year hasn't been his year, however. He currently sits seventh in the standings with just three races left and is yet to win a race. Asked whether his lack of title contention has been a blow to him, he's keen to focus on the upside of his year so far.

"Yes and no," he said. "I want to be in a championship fight every year if I can be, but also, it's definitely a bit more relaxed this year. Obviously, we're not wanting to be in this position, but there's not quite the same stress.

"But that stress that you have in a championship fight is the feeling you want, because it means you're fighting for something that is what your goal is. I am missing that feeling this year for sure."
McLaren has struggled to match the pace it showed in the last two seasons under F1's new rules, and Piastri said the car had been tricky from the start.

"It wasn't that easy to drive, and it's still not been easy to drive, even now," he said. "It took us a while to understand exactly what needed to change, and then trying to actually change it is tough. But we're making progress with it slowly."

There were hints of that in Brazil. Norris won at Interlagos on Sunday with a car that McLaren had upgraded with a new front wing designed to make it more predictable, while Piastri recovered to sixth after being knocked out in Q2.

Piastri now has something else to aim for. McLaren sits fourth in the constructors' championship, 17 points behind Red Bull, and he said after the race that closing that gap was his priority for the rest of the season.

"Just keep learning and ultimately try and beat Red Bull in the constructors' championship. That's the big thing," he said. "It's not going to be an easy task for sure, but I think it's possible. I think the car took a step forward this weekend, so hopefully that keeps going."
Piastri also confirmed on Monday that he had split from his manager Mark Webber, the former Red Bull driver who had guided his career since his junior days.
He will get his next chance to close the gap to Red Bull in Las Vegas next week.

detailZh: “科拉平托从未切到弯心”——奥迪对巴西站霍肯伯格争议罚时的看法
霍肯伯格在英特拉格斯因在试图超越弗朗哥·科拉平托时离开赛道并获得优势而被罚10秒
奥迪在车队积分榜上排名第八，这与赛车的竞争力并不太相符，但种种情况叠加，让车队在2026年始终未能进入积分区。尼科·霍肯伯格和加布里埃尔·博托莱托两人合计已有十次第11名完赛。
问题往往出在起步表现不佳，这让车手在离开发车格后损失了赛道位置。但英特拉格斯的混合条件让霍肯伯格得以发挥，尽管他在第48圈与阿尔派的弗朗哥·科拉平托争夺最后一个积分席位时，因在一号弯离开赛道并获得优势而被罚10秒。
霍肯伯格在周六受雨水影响的排位赛中闯入前十名争夺战，并做出第六快的时间——由于乔治·拉塞尔和夏尔·勒克莱尔被罚，他在发车格上升至第四。他在开场圈跌至第六，但随后一直坚守，直到赛道开始变干时马克斯·维斯塔潘和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里将他超越。
换上干地轮胎后，霍肯伯格也落在了刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔驾驶的两辆法拉利之后，但他仍有望拿分，直到第44圈的第二次进站让他落到了科拉平托身后，后者自第17圈结束以来就再未进站。尽管轮胎老化，这位阿尔派车手仍顽强防守，霍肯伯格花了四圈才在第1弯完成超越——但他在外线绕行时驶过了沥青缓冲区。
霍肯伯格随后因离开赛道并获得优势而被处以10秒罚时。奥迪车队赛事总监艾伦·麦克尼什解释了车队为何没有指示霍肯伯格交还位置。
尼科·霍肯伯格，奥迪F1车队，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
麦克尼什表示：“相对于法拉利车队，我们的竞争力让我感到相当惊喜。”
“在湿滑条件下，与他们相比我们看起来相当不错。尼科（霍肯伯格）能够稳住并守住位置。在干地换上光头胎后，我们的表现没有达到预期。我们在那里有些挣扎。”
“也许是条件原因，我不确定。但相对于竞争对手，我们确实没有达到同样的速度水平。不过仍然在前十名之内。”
“当我们进站时，他（霍肯伯格）出来时正好遇到科拉平托。科拉平托当时处于使用旧胎的赛段尾声，勉强支撑并在1号弯跑宽了。他又做了一次，因为尼科在外线——就是把他挤宽了，错过了弯心。但因为尼科驶出赛道，随后被认为获得了持久优势，所以我们被罚了10秒。”
“对我们来说，情况并不明确。通常如果你在弯心处于领先位置，那么你就有权获得该位置。由于1号弯向下进入‘S’弯的方式，弯心的位置非常主观。科拉平托根本没有碰到弯心。他离弯心差得远。他离弯心还有很长一段距离。
“但国际汽联定义了弯心线在哪里。而在那个点上，科拉平托已经跑宽了。所以，对我们来说，这是一个非常有争议的情况。我们老实说不知道该怎么处理。如果我们把位置还回去，那么我们就会陷入同样的位置。
“另一个因素是，等到我们能够回看的时候，尼科已经领先太多了。他在那一圈拉开了两秒。
“你必须遵守国际汽联的裁决。这毫无疑问。但对我们来说，并不清楚那不是尼科的弯角——这是最好的说法。”
国际汽联的驾驶指南规定，试图在弯道外侧超车的车手，只有在弯心处其前轴领先于另一辆车的前轴时，才有权获得“赛车空间”。虽然1号弯的地形使得精确判断弯心位置变得困难，但干事们确实必须在某处划定界线，而霍肯伯格被判定在那一刻未达到该标准。
此外，驾驶指南规定，尝试超车的车辆必须“从入弯、到弯心、再到出弯都处于受控驾驶状态”，并且“能够在赛道限制内完成该弯道”。
后几条条款近年来经过了细化，因为一些车手被认为利用了早期版本指南中规定不那么具体的规定。但关于进攻车手是否发动了神风式突击，或者防守车手是否也通过‘意外’跑宽而占了便宜，仍然经常存在争论。
在他最后一次进站时执行10秒罚时——当时正值比赛中所有车手因雨带扫过赛道而换回半雨胎的阶段——这让霍肯伯格再次跌出前十。但他在第65圈开始时从阿维德·林德布拉德手中夺回了第10名。
麦克尼什说：“对林德布拉德的那次超车，我认为绝对是一次漂亮且富有侵略性的超车。这也是一种宣言：你们可以给我们处罚，但我们依然能把它追回来。”
detailEn: "Colapinto never hit the apex" – Audi's take on contentious Nico Hulkenberg penalty in Brazilian GP
Hulkenberg was hit with a 10-second penalty at Interlagos for leaving the track and gaining an advantage while trying to pass Franco Colapinto

Audi's eighth place in the constructors' championship doesn't quite tally with the competitiveness of its car, but circumstances have contrived to keep the team falling short of the points in 2026. Between them, Nico Hulkenberg and Gabriel Bortoleto have notched up ten 11th-place finishes.

Often the issue has been poor starting performance which costs the drivers track position away from the grid. But the mixed conditions at Interlagos enabled Hulkenberg to shine, despite a 10-second penalty for leaving the track and gaining an advantage at Turn 1 while battling Alpine's Franco Colapinto for the final points-paying spot on lap 48.

Hulkenberg had made it through to the top-10 shootout in the rain-affected qualifying session on Saturday, and set the sixth-fastest time – which became fourth on the grid thanks to penalties for George Russell and Charles Leclerc. He dropped back to sixth on the opening lap but then held on until Max Verstappen and Oscar Piastri demoted him as the track began to dry out.

On the slick tyres Hulkenberg also fell behind the Ferraris of Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc but he was still on course for points until his second pitstop on lap 44 dropped him behind Colapinto, who hadn't stopped since the end of lap 17. Despite his ageing tyres, the Alpine driver put up a stubborn defence and it took Hulkenberg four laps to make a pass stick at Turn 1 – but in going around the outside he strayed through the asphalt run-off.

Hulkenberg was subsequently hit with a 10-second penalty for leaving the track and gaining an advantage. Audi's racing director Allan McNish explained why the team didn't instruct Hulkenberg to give the position back.
Nico Hulkenberg, Audi F1 Team, George Russell, Mercedes
"I was quite positively surprised how competitive we were relative to the Ferraris," said McNish.

"We looked pretty good in the wet conditions in comparison to them. And Nico was able to hold on and keep his position. In the dry, when we switched to the slicks, we didn't quite have the same performance as what we had hoped. We struggled a little bit there.
"Maybe the conditions, I'm not sure. But we didn't quite have that same level of speed relative to the competition. But still in the top 10.

"When we did the pitstop, he [Hulkenberg] was coming out with Colapinto. And Colapinto was at the end of his stint on old tyres, hanging on and running wide into Turn 1. He did it again because Nico was on the outside – just pushed him wide, missed the apex. But because Nico went off and then was deemed to have gained the long and lasting advantage, then we had a 10-second penalty.

"For us it wasn't clear. Normally if you're ahead at the apex, then you have the right to be given position. Because of how it [Turn 1] drops down into the ‘S', then it's very subjective where the apex is. Now Colapinto never hit the apex. He was nowhere near the apex. He was a long way from the apex.

"But the FIA defined where the apex line was. And at that point Colapinto had ran wide. So, for us, it was a very debatable situation. And we honestly didn't know which way to go with it. If we had given it back, then we were stuck in the same position.
"And the other factor was that by the time we had been able to review, Nico had gone so far ahead. He pulled two seconds on the lap.
"You have to follow the FIA ruling. There's no question. But it wasn't clear for us that it wasn't Nico's corner – that's the best way to put it."

The FIA's driving guidelines state that a driver trying to pass around the outside of a corner is entitled to ‘racing room' only if their front axle is ahead of the other car's front axle at the apex. While the topography of Turn 1 makes identifying precisely where the apex is difficult, the stewards literally have to draw the line somewhere, and Hulkenberg was adjudged not to have met the threshold by that point.

Additionally, the driving guidelines state that the car attempting the overtake must "be driven in a controlled manner from entry, to apex, and to exit" and "be able to make the corner within track limits".

These latter clauses have been finessed in recent years because some drivers were deemed to have exploited less prescriptive earlier versions of the guidelines. But there are still often debates about whether an attacking driver has launched a kamikaze-style assault, or whether the defender has also taken liberties by ‘accidentally' running wide.

Serving the 10-second penalty at his final pitstop, during a phase of the race in which the entire field switched back to intermediate tyres as a band of rain swept across the circuit, dropped Hulkenberg out of the top 10 again. But he relieved Arvid Lindblad of 10th place at the start of lap 65.
"The overtake [on Lindblad] was one that definitely I think was good and aggressive," said McNish. "And it was also a delivery of a statement: give us a penalty, but we can still get it back."

items.originalTitle: What the Brazilian GP revealed about F1's ability to cope with rain
items.summaryEn: The mixed conditions at the Brazilian Grand Prix provided the first opportunity to test how the new cars perform in the wet, following concerns about wet races.
detailZh: 巴西大奖赛揭示F1应对雨水的能力
在受雨水影响的排位赛之后，正赛当天的混合条件首次提供了机会，来直面关于新车在湿地表现如何的担忧。
自赛季开始前，雨战可能发生的情况就一直困扰着F1的利益相关者。这也全年引发了一些不必要的歇斯底里式评论，在上周末英特拉格斯巴西大奖赛前夕达到顶峰，当时排位赛和正赛有雨几乎已成定局，为本赛季首次。
尽管在马来西亚举行的巴林大奖赛曾因雨水和发现软件故障而中断，但等到比赛开始时，赛道正在迅速变干。巴西的情况并非如此。
英特拉格斯赛道的排位赛因暴雨恰逢本节开始而被红旗中断80分钟，事后许多媒体纷纷援引乔治·拉塞尔一句颇为辛辣的言论。
“我喜欢在这里的雨中驾驶，但到了某个节点，如果那是一场正赛，我们绝不该在那种条件下继续驾驶，因为发生极其可怕事故的概率非常非常高，”他说。
这堪称制造喧闹新闻的完美标题素材，但缺乏上下文。那节排位赛之后，围场内的普遍共识是国际汽联在正确的时间做出了正确的决定：在最初暴雨来袭时立即中止第一节排位赛，随后以极大的严谨态度寻找安全的‘窗口’重新开始。
“总的来说，我想比赛，但昨天（周六）我认为那是完美的决定，”法拉利车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔在正赛后说。
“当我们在红旗出现前完成第一圈[Q1]时，赛车回来时车里积了两厘米深的水……”
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利车队；卡洛斯·塞恩斯，威廉姆斯车队；阿维德·林德布拉德，小红牛车队
那样的条件太湿了，除了在维修区里赛船之外，任何形式的赛道活动都无法进行。真正的问题在于，赛车和最新一代轮胎在那种潮湿和/或快速变化的状况下会有怎样的表现——而排位赛和正赛恰恰有可能正是在这种状况下进行的。
从历史上看，倍耐力带有深花纹的“极端”雨胎很少被使用，因为它们工作窗口的很大一部分都落在被认为可接受的比赛条件范围之外。它们能排开大量积水，但随着赛道变干，胎面块会过快过热。等到赛道湿到足以证明使用“极端”雨胎合理时，通常红旗已经迫在眉睫。
因此，半雨胎一直是湿地条件下的首选，但据了解，今年的半雨胎太“硬”，升温太慢。鉴于测试限制，倍耐力一直无法用本赛季规定的更窄轮胎完成同等条件的测试。
长期以来，人们一直担心新半雨胎抓地力不足，再加上最新一代发动机更猛烈的扭矩输出，会使2026年的F1赛车在湿地条件下危险到无法驾驶。因此，巴西大奖赛周末前出现了恐慌情绪。
实际发生的事情没有那么戏剧化，也更微妙。英特拉格斯赛道路面的性质意味着可驾驶性偶尔会成为问题，但并非总是如此。在幕后，国际汽联自年初以来一直在做大量工作，以管理这些条件下的动力输出。
亚历山大·阿尔本，威廉姆斯，卡洛斯·塞恩斯，威廉姆斯
排位赛——一旦开始——曾让人燃起希望，认为“极端”雨胎如今更实用了，但半雨胎的问题则稍多一些。基米·安东内利在前往发车格的圈中于茹卡奥弯冲出赛道，另有数位车手反映，当最后10圈的降雨迫使大家换回半雨胎时，他们的赛车又变得难以驾驭。
“我认为好的一点是，我们比过去能更多地使用‘大雨胎’，”瓦塞尔说。“这是好事，因为当情况更接近‘大雨胎’或介于两者之间时，它不会逼着你去用半雨胎，从而让你冒风险。
“我觉得排位赛相当不错……但抓地力也完全不同。你今天在前往发车格的圈里看到，所有人都跟见了鬼一样。我认为在这些条件下，这是一条很难的赛道。”
倍耐力明年的目标是把雨胎配方的性能拉得更接近，让半雨胎升温更快，‘极端’雨胎更耐磨损。但这在工程上是个挑战，因为各条赛道在轮胎所承受的能量方面差异太大。
“很难让它们升温，但它们也磨损得相当快，”在巴西站获得第15名的亚历克斯·阿尔本说道。
“所以即使它们处于低温状态，也在磨损，感觉它们永远不会过热，或者永远达不到工作温度。然后等到你开始跑圈时，胎面已经脱落了，然后你就已经陷入挣扎，四处打滑。所以，在比赛的任何时刻你都感觉不好；它从来都不像是进入了工作状态。”
这可以解释开场几圈的一些异常现象：排在发车格前列的车手发现自己不得不格外谨慎，因为他们感受不到抓地力——而一些排在后面的车手，等待熄灯的时间更短，却获得了强劲的起步。
即便在这些人当中也存在差异：马克斯·维斯塔潘和刘易斯·汉密尔顿分别从发车格第20位和第21位迅速杀入前十，但随后汉密尔顿又掉了回去，因为他的赛车出现了严重的转向过度甩尾。维斯塔潘和基米·安东内利一样，随后发现自己的赛车在使用光头胎时性能下降。
湿地条件增加了排位赛的戏剧性
干湿两种轮胎配方下性能表现参差不齐，这很难理清，但共识仍然是雨胎需要更多研发。有一些小抱怨，但并没有出现人们所担心和大声预测的灾难。
卡洛斯·塞恩斯表示：“我认为半雨胎和全雨胎的水平还不够好，我们需要与倍耐力合作寻找更好的轮胎，因为在混合条件下，半雨胎的后轮仍然是非常弱的轮胎。等它升温时，前轮已经不行了。”
“而全雨胎，说实话，昨天我们打滑太多了，后轮抓地力严重不足，所以这两款轮胎仍然缺少一些研发。”
虽然本周末在多种不同条件下收集到的数据会很有用，但这仍然只是一个孤立的例子。鉴于路面和环境温度的差异，在英特拉格斯奏效或不奏效的做法，未必能照搬到其他地方。
“我会说相当棘手，”这是利亚姆·劳森对驾驶2026年F1赛车在湿地比赛的评价。
“今天最大的问题是环境温度比昨天低得多。所以即使积水更少，在驶向发车格的圈里赛车几乎无法驾驶，而且温度还在不断下降。
“所以，我们撑过了比赛开始阶段，但在雨下得很大的时候，半雨胎就变得……并不是说积水太多，而是你实际上无法保持轮胎温度。所以，如果我们在像拉斯维加斯这样的赛道上遇到下雨，老实说，我认为我们会陷入麻烦。
“但总的来说，很明显我们第一次用这些轮胎完整度过了一个比赛周末。”
补充报道：Roberto Chinchero 和 Guilherme Longo
detailEn: What the Brazilian GP revealed about F1's ability to cope with rain
Mixed conditions on race day, following a rain-affected qualifying session, was the first opportunity to confront fears about how the new cars would perform in the wet

The question of what might happen in a wet race has vexed Formula 1's stakeholders since before the beginning of the season. It's also prompted some unnecessarily hysterical commentary throughout the year, peaking in the run-up to last weekend's Brazilian Grand Prix at Interlagos, where rain for qualifying and the race was a virtual certainty for the first time this season.

Although the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia was interrupted by rain and the discovery of a software glitch, by the time the race got going the track was drying quickly. This was not the case in Brazil.
Qualifying at Interlagos was red-flagged for 80 minutes after a downpour coincided with the start of the session, and many media outlets alighted on a spicy George Russell quote in the aftermath.

"I love driving in the rain here but, at some point, if that was a race, there was no way we should be driving in that because the chances of seeing a really, really horrific incident are very, very high," he said.

Perfect headline material for a noisy story, but context was lacking. The general consensus within the paddock after that session was that the FIA made the right calls at the right time, immediately suspending Q1 during the initial downpour, then applying great rigour to identify a safe ‘window' to restart it.
"In general, I want to race, but yesterday [Saturday] I think it was the perfect call," said Ferrari team principal Frederic Vasseur after the race.
"When we did the first [Q1] lap before the red flag, we came back with two centimetres of water in the car…"
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Carlos Sainz, Williams, Arvid Lindblad, Racing Bulls

Those conditions were too wet to stage any kind of track activity beyond a boat race in the pitlane. The real questions surrounded how the cars and the latest generation of tyres would perform in the kind of wet and/or rapidly changing circumstances in which qualifying and the race could actually be staged.

Historically, Pirelli's heavily treaded ‘extreme' wet tyres are rarely seen, since too much of their operating window sits outside the margin of what is considered to be acceptable racing conditions. They displace massive quantities of water but the tread blocks overheat too quickly as the track dries. By the time the track is wet enough to justify the ‘extreme' tyre, a red flag is usually imminent.

The intermediate tyres have therefore been the wet-weather boots of choice, but this year's are understood to be too ‘hard' and slow to come up to operating temperature. Pirelli just hasn't been able to accomplish like-for-like running with the narrower wheels mandated for this season, given the testing restrictions.

It's long been feared that lack of grip from the new intermediates, combined with the more brutal torque delivery of the latest generation of engines, would make the 2026 F1 cars dangerously undriveable in the wet. Hence the outbreak of hysteria ahead of the Brazil weekend.

What actually transpired was less dramatic, and more nuanced. The nature of the track surface at Interlagos meant driveability was occasionally an issue, but not always. In the background, the FIA has been doing a lot of work since the beginning of the year to manage power delivery in these conditions.
Alexander Albon, Williams, Carlos Sainz, Williams

While qualifying – once it got started – offered some hope that the ‘extreme' wets are now more useable, the intermediates were a little more problematic. Kimi Antonelli went off at Juncao on his lap to the grid, and several other drivers reported their cars became a handful again when rain in the last 10 laps dictated a return to the intermediates.

"I think what is good is that we can use the 'big wet' much more than in the past," said Vasseur. "And this is good because it's not pushing you to use inter when it's a more 'big wet' situation, or mix between the two, and then you are taking risks.

"I think the quali was pretty good… but also the grip was completely different. You saw in the lap to the grid today that everybody was completely like hell. I think it's a difficult track with these conditions."

Pirelli's target for next year is to bring the performance of the wet-weather compounds closer together, so the intermediate warms up faster and the ‘extreme' is more resistant to wear. But this is a challenge to engineer because the tracks differ so much in terms of the energy going through the tyres.
"It was difficult to fire them up but they also wore quite quickly," said Alex Albon, who finished 15th in Brazil.

"So even when they're cold, they're wearing and it just feels like they never overheat, or they never level up to temperature. And then by the time you're circulating, the tread's already come off the tyre and then you're already struggling, you're sliding around. So, you never feel good at any point in the race; it never feels like it comes alive."

This would explain some of the peculiarities of the opening laps, where those at the front of the grid found themselves having to be super-cautious because they couldn't feel the grip – while some of those towards the rear, who spent less time waiting for lights-out, got strong getaways.

Even among those there was a variance: Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton quickly broke through to the top 10 from 20th and 21st on the grid, only for Hamilton to then go backwards as his car developed massive oversteer snaps. Verstappen, like Kimi Antonelli, then found his car less performant on the slicks.
Wet conditions added to the drama of qualifying

This mixed spread of performance over the wet and dry tyre compounds will be tricky to unpick, but the consensus remained that the wet-weather rubber needs more development. There were minor gripes but not the disasters that were feared and noisily predicted.

"I think the level of the wet and the inter is not good enough and we need to work with Pirelli on finding a better tyre," said Carlos Sainz, "because in the mixed conditions the inter is still a very weak tyre at the rear. By the time it warms up, the front is gone.
"And the extreme, honestly, yesterday we had so much sliding and a big lack of rear grip, so still missing a bit of development on these two tyres."

While the data gathered through running in many different conditions this weekend will be useful, it's still an isolated example. What worked or didn't work at Interlagos may not translate elsewhere, given variances in surfaces and ambient temperatures.
"Quite tricky I would say," was Liam Lawson's take on racing in the wet in a 2026 F1 car.

"The biggest problem today is the [ambient] temperature was much cooler than yesterday. And so even though there was less water, on the laps of the grid the cars were nearly undriveable, and the temps were just going down.

"So, we survived the start of the race but at points when it rains a lot, the inter becomes... it's not that the standing water's too much, it's that you can't actually keep the temperature in it. So, if we're on a track like Vegas and it rains, honestly, I think we're in trouble.
"But overall, obviously we got through a weekend for the first time with these tyres."
Additional reporting by Roberto Chinchero and Guilherme Longo
